items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: I was in college when I joined Jack Teagarden when I was 19.

ctx.x: Studying piano through grade school, high school, and part college. I was in college when I joined Jack Teagarden when I was 19. I went from a Missouri farm boy to New York City, it scared me to death.
Was that culture shock or what?
